notes: UNSEEN fixture authored AFTER the cue-lexicon freeze (commit 996fdd3) and BEFORE the first run on it, per retrieval-design.md section 9.
Zero identifier/file/symbol overlap with fixture-1; identifiers avoid generic English retrieval-intent words (the 'use' lesson).
Golds are utility judgments from goal text alone (method-agnostic), frozen before the first run. They were NOT tuned to any method output.
Method M1 is now the goal-aware retrieval layer (cue-lexicon v1.0.0) over the F1-F7-fixed engine; B0/B1 definitions are unchanged from fixture-1.

method.M1_aware: GoalRetriever.retrieve(graph, seed, goal) per cue-lexicon v1.0.0: goal text selects only a direction/class; the source graph produces all candidates; gold is never a runtime input.
method.B0_keywords: goal tokens (lowercase, split on [^a-z0-9]+) minus STOPWORDS; a file matches if its content contains ANY keyword as a case-insensitive substring (union/OR). Result = all index symbols of matched files.
method.B1_closure: seed file + depth-1 both-direction import closure from an INDEPENDENT regex scan (no pilot code reuse). Result = all index symbols of those files.
method.metrics: Per-task exact-match set precision/recall vs relevant. PRIMARY: macro-average. Secondary: micro. Soft bars (owner, D-0022): macro P >= 0.90 and macro R >= B1 - 0.05; reported, not gate-blocking.
